```{r ammonia_setup}
# ---- Ammonia mapping setup ----

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(stringr)
library(viridis)

project_root <- "/Users/richardbeaumont/R_projects/1st_Paper"

ammonia_dir <- file.path(project_root, "contextual_mapping", "ammonia_mapping")
ammonia_raw_dir <- file.path(ammonia_dir, "raw_data")
ammonia_processed_dir <- file.path(ammonia_dir, "processed_data")
ammonia_fig_dir <- file.path(ammonia_dir, "figures")

dir.create(ammonia_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(ammonia_raw_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(ammonia_processed_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(ammonia_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sheffield_purple <- "#7A1FA2"
defra_orange <- "#E57200"
```

```{r check_approved_samhe_datasets}
# ---- Check approved SAMHE/AURN datasets ----
# These are used directly. No additional exclusion rules are applied.

required_objects <- c(
  "In_Out_24",
  "In_Out_SchHrs",
  "In_Out_OutSchHrs"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !required_objects %in% ls(envir = .GlobalEnv)
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required object(s): ",
    paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

required_columns <- c(
  "SchoolId_short",
  "SchoolLongitude",
  "SchoolLatitude",
  "DateTime",
  "pm02",
  "pm2.5"
)

for (object_name in required_objects) {
  
  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(get(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv))
  )
  
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      object_name,
      " is missing column(s): ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
}
```

```{r import_naei_nh3_2023_rasters}
# ---- Import NAEI NH3 2023 GeoTIFF layers ----

naei_year <- 2023

naei_nh3_folder <- file.path(
  ammonia_raw_dir,
  "naei23_nh3_2023",
  "GeoTIFF_layers"
)

naei_nh3_files <- list.files(
  naei_nh3_folder,
  pattern = "\\.tif$|\\.tiff$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

naei_nh3_inventory <- tibble(
  file_path = naei_nh3_files,
  file_name = basename(naei_nh3_files)
) %>%
  mutate(
    sector = case_when(
      str_detect(file_name, "^02nonindustcomb") ~ "02nonindustcomb",
      str_detect(file_name, "^03industcomb") ~ "03industcomb",
      str_detect(file_name, "^04prodprocess") ~ "04prodprocess",
      str_detect(file_name, "^06solvents") ~ "06solvents",
      str_detect(file_name, "^07roadtrans") ~ "07roadtrans",
      str_detect(file_name, "^08othertrans") ~ "08othertrans",
      str_detect(file_name, "^09waste") ~ "09waste",
      str_detect(file_name, "^10agriculture") ~ "10agriculture",
      str_detect(file_name, "^11nature") ~ "11nature",
      str_detect(file_name, "^total") ~ "total",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(sector != "unknown") %>%
  arrange(sector)

if (nrow(naei_nh3_inventory) == 0) {
  stop("No NAEI NH3 GeoTIFF files found in: ", naei_nh3_folder)
}

naei_nh3_rasters <- terra::rast(
  naei_nh3_inventory$file_path
)

names(naei_nh3_rasters) <- naei_nh3_inventory$sector

naei_nh3_metadata <- tibble(
  year = naei_year,
  sector = names(naei_nh3_rasters),
  nrow = terra::nrow(naei_nh3_rasters),
  ncol = terra::ncol(naei_nh3_rasters),
  crs = terra::crs(naei_nh3_rasters),
  xmin = terra::ext(naei_nh3_rasters)[1],
  xmax = terra::ext(naei_nh3_rasters)[2],
  ymin = terra::ext(naei_nh3_rasters)[3],
  ymax = terra::ext(naei_nh3_rasters)[4]
)

saveRDS(
  naei_nh3_inventory,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "naei_nh3_2023_file_inventory.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  naei_nh3_metadata,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "naei_nh3_2023_metadata.rds")
)

naei_nh3_rasters
```

```{r extract_naei_nh3_school_buffers}
# ---- Extract NAEI NH3 values for each school ----
# Uses the union of schools from In_Out_24, In_Out_SchHrs and In_Out_OutSchHrs.
# gridcell = raster cell containing the school.
# 1, 2, 5 and 10 km = mean raster value within circular buffer.

ammonia_school_context <- local({

  school_coordinates <- bind_rows(
    In_Out_24 %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, SchoolLongitude, SchoolLatitude),
    In_Out_SchHrs %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, SchoolLongitude, SchoolLatitude),
    In_Out_OutSchHrs %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, SchoolLongitude, SchoolLatitude)
  ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(SchoolLongitude),
      !is.na(SchoolLatitude)
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      SchoolId_short,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  school_sf <- st_as_sf(
    school_coordinates,
    coords = c("SchoolLongitude", "SchoolLatitude"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )

  school_bng <- st_transform(
    school_sf,
    crs = terra::crs(naei_nh3_rasters)
  )

  school_vect <- terra::vect(school_bng)

  gridcell_values <- terra::extract(
    naei_nh3_rasters,
    school_vect
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    select(-ID) %>%
    bind_cols(
      school_coordinates %>% select(SchoolId_short),
      .
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -SchoolId_short,
      names_to = "sector",
      values_to = "nh3_value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      buffer_km = 0
    )

  extract_buffer <- function(buffer_m) {
    
    buffer_values <- terra::extract(
      naei_nh3_rasters,
      terra::buffer(school_vect, width = buffer_m),
      fun = mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      select(-ID)
    
    bind_cols(
      school_coordinates %>% select(SchoolId_short),
      buffer_values
    ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -SchoolId_short,
        names_to = "sector",
        values_to = "nh3_value"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        buffer_km = buffer_m / 1000
      )
  }

  buffer_values <- bind_rows(
    extract_buffer(1000),
    extract_buffer(2000),
    extract_buffer(5000),
    extract_buffer(10000)
  )

  school_ammonia_context_long <- bind_rows(
    gridcell_values,
    buffer_values
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = naei_year,
      sector_label = case_when(
        sector == "02nonindustcomb" ~ "Non-industrial combustion",
        sector == "03industcomb" ~ "Industrial combustion",
        sector == "04prodprocess" ~ "Production processes",
        sector == "06solvents" ~ "Solvents",
        sector == "07roadtrans" ~ "Road transport",
        sector == "08othertrans" ~ "Other transport",
        sector == "09waste" ~ "Waste",
        sector == "10agriculture" ~ "Agriculture",
        sector == "11nature" ~ "Nature",
        sector == "total" ~ "Total",
        TRUE ~ sector
      )
    )

  school_ammonia_context_wide <- school_ammonia_context_long %>%
    mutate(
      variable_name = paste0(
        "nh3_",
        sector,
        "_",
        ifelse(buffer_km == 0, "gridcell", paste0(buffer_km, "km"))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      SchoolId_short,
      variable_name,
      nh3_value
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = variable_name,
      values_from = nh3_value
    )

  gridded_sector_sum_wide <- school_ammonia_context_long %>%
    filter(sector != "total") %>%
    group_by(SchoolId_short, buffer_km) %>%
    summarise(
      nh3_value = sum(nh3_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      variable_name = paste0(
        "nh3_gridded_sector_sum_",
        ifelse(buffer_km == 0, "gridcell", paste0(buffer_km, "km"))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      SchoolId_short,
      variable_name,
      nh3_value
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = variable_name,
      values_from = nh3_value
    )

  school_ammonia_context_wide <- school_ammonia_context_wide %>%
    left_join(
      gridded_sector_sum_wide,
      by = "SchoolId_short"
    )

  list(
    school_coordinates = school_coordinates,
    long = school_ammonia_context_long,
    wide = school_ammonia_context_wide
  )
})

saveRDS(
  ammonia_school_context,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "ammonia_school_context.rds")
)

ammonia_school_context$long %>%
  count(sector, buffer_km)

ammonia_school_context$wide
```

```{r create_ammonia_pm25_results}
# ---- Create main NH3-PM2.5 analysis object ----
# One row = one school per period.
# No additional exclusion rules are applied.

ammonia_pm25_results <- local({

  summarise_pm25_by_school <- function(data, period_label) {
    
    data %>%
      group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
      summarise(
        indoor_pm25_mean = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
        indoor_pm25_median = median(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
        outdoor_pm25_mean = mean(`pm2.5`, na.rm = TRUE),
        outdoor_pm25_median = median(`pm2.5`, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_observations = n(),
        n_days = n_distinct(as.Date(DateTime)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        period = period_label,
        io_ratio_mean = indoor_pm25_mean / outdoor_pm25_mean,
        io_ratio_median = indoor_pm25_median / outdoor_pm25_median
      )
  }

  school_pm25_ammonia <- bind_rows(
    summarise_pm25_by_school(In_Out_24, "All hours"),
    summarise_pm25_by_school(In_Out_SchHrs, "School hours"),
    summarise_pm25_by_school(In_Out_OutSchHrs, "Out of school hours")
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      ammonia_school_context$wide,
      by = "SchoolId_short"
    )

  if (exists("df_school_chars")) {
    
    school_chars <- df_school_chars %>%
      distinct(
        SchoolId_short,
        .keep_all = TRUE
      )
    
    school_pm25_ammonia <- school_pm25_ammonia %>%
      left_join(
        school_chars,
        by = "SchoolId_short",
        suffix = c("", "_school_chars")
      )
  }

  list(
    school_pm25_ammonia = school_pm25_ammonia
  )
})

saveRDS(
  ammonia_pm25_results,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "ammonia_pm25_results.rds")
)

ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia
```

```{r ammonia_pm25_correlations}
# ---- NH3-PM2.5 correlations ----
# Tests indoor PM2.5, outdoor PM2.5 and I/O ratio against NH3 context.

ammonia_pm25_results$correlations <- local({

  ammonia_variables <- c(
    "nh3_10agriculture_1km",
    "nh3_10agriculture_2km",
    "nh3_10agriculture_5km",
    "nh3_10agriculture_10km",
    "nh3_gridded_sector_sum_1km",
    "nh3_total_1km"
  )

  ammonia_variables <- ammonia_variables[
    ammonia_variables %in% names(ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia)
  ]

  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      unique(ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia$period),
      function(period_name) {
        
        period_data <- ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia %>%
          filter(period == period_name)
        
        bind_rows(
          lapply(
            ammonia_variables,
            function(ammonia_var) {
              
              test_data <- period_data %>%
                select(
                  nh3_value = all_of(ammonia_var),
                  indoor_pm25_mean,
                  outdoor_pm25_mean,
                  io_ratio_mean
                ) %>%
                filter(
                  is.finite(nh3_value),
                  is.finite(indoor_pm25_mean),
                  is.finite(outdoor_pm25_mean),
                  is.finite(io_ratio_mean),
                  nh3_value > 0
                )
              
              indoor_test <- cor.test(
                test_data$nh3_value,
                test_data$indoor_pm25_mean,
                method = "spearman",
                exact = FALSE
              )
              
              outdoor_test <- cor.test(
                test_data$nh3_value,
                test_data$outdoor_pm25_mean,
                method = "spearman",
                exact = FALSE
              )
              
              io_test <- cor.test(
                test_data$nh3_value,
                test_data$io_ratio_mean,
                method = "spearman",
                exact = FALSE
              )
              
              tibble(
                period = period_name,
                ammonia_variable = ammonia_var,
                n_schools = nrow(test_data),
                rho_indoor_pm25 = unname(indoor_test$estimate),
                p_indoor_pm25 = indoor_test$p.value,
                rho_outdoor_pm25 = unname(outdoor_test$estimate),
                p_outdoor_pm25 = outdoor_test$p.value,
                rho_io_ratio = unname(io_test$estimate),
                p_io_ratio = io_test$p.value
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  ) %>%
    arrange(period, p_indoor_pm25)
})

saveRDS(
  ammonia_pm25_results,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "ammonia_pm25_results.rds")
)

ammonia_pm25_results$correlations
```

```{r agricultural_nh3_adjusted_tests}
# ---- Adjusted test for agricultural NH3 ----
# Tests whether agricultural NH3 explains classroom PM2.5 after accounting for outdoor PM2.5.

ammonia_pm25_results$agriculture_adjusted <- local({

  test_data <- ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia %>%
    filter(period == "School hours") %>%
    select(
      SchoolId_short,
      indoor_pm25_mean,
      outdoor_pm25_mean,
      nh3_10agriculture_1km,
      nh3_10agriculture_2km,
      nh3_10agriculture_5km,
      nh3_10agriculture_10km
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("nh3_10agriculture_"),
      names_to = "ammonia_variable",
      values_to = "nh3_value"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(indoor_pm25_mean),
      is.finite(outdoor_pm25_mean),
      is.finite(nh3_value),
      nh3_value > 0,
      outdoor_pm25_mean > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      log_nh3 = log10(nh3_value)
    )

  test_data %>%
    group_by(ammonia_variable) %>%
    group_modify(
      ~ {
        
        model_without_nh3 <- lm(
          indoor_pm25_mean ~ outdoor_pm25_mean,
          data = .x
        )
        
        model_with_nh3 <- lm(
          indoor_pm25_mean ~ outdoor_pm25_mean + log_nh3,
          data = .x
        )
        
        model_comparison <- anova(
          model_without_nh3,
          model_with_nh3
        )
        
        tibble(
          n_schools = nrow(.x),
          r2_without_nh3 = summary(model_without_nh3)$r.squared,
          r2_with_nh3 = summary(model_with_nh3)$r.squared,
          delta_r2 = r2_with_nh3 - r2_without_nh3,
          nh3_coefficient = coef(summary(model_with_nh3))["log_nh3", "Estimate"],
          nh3_p_value = coef(summary(model_with_nh3))["log_nh3", "Pr(>|t|)"],
          model_comparison_p_value = model_comparison$`Pr(>F)`[2]
        )
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(nh3_p_value)
})

saveRDS(
  ammonia_pm25_results,
  file.path(ammonia_processed_dir, "ammonia_pm25_results.rds")
)

ammonia_pm25_results$agriculture_adjusted
```

```{r static_naei_nh3_with_samhe_schools}
# ---- Static map of NAEI NH3 with SAMHE schools ----
# Uses the original NAEI British National Grid raster.
# Uses In_Out_24 only for SAMHE school coordinates.
# No OSM tiles are used, avoiding raster-basemap alignment problems.

library(rnaturalearth)
library(viridisLite)

# ---- Select NAEI total NH3 raster ----

naei_total_nh3 <- naei_nh3_rasters[["total"]]

# ---- UK land boundary in the same CRS as the NAEI raster ----
# A small buffer keeps coastal cells and small islands.

uk_land <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  country = "United Kingdom",
  scale = "large",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  sf::st_transform(
    crs = terra::crs(naei_total_nh3)
  ) %>%
  sf::st_buffer(
    dist = 5000
  )

uk_land_vect <- terra::vect(uk_land)

# ---- Crop and mask raster to UK land ----

naei_total_nh3_uk <- terra::crop(
  naei_total_nh3,
  uk_land_vect
)

naei_total_nh3_uk <- terra::mask(
  naei_total_nh3_uk,
  uk_land_vect
)

# ---- Convert raster to data frame ----

naei_total_nh3_df <- as.data.frame(
  naei_total_nh3_uk,
  xy = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

names(naei_total_nh3_df) <- c(
  "x",
  "y",
  "nh3_value"
)

# ---- Classify into fixed legend bands ----

naei_total_nh3_df <- naei_total_nh3_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(nh3_value)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    nh3_class = dplyr::case_when(
      nh3_value < 0.05 ~ "< 0.05",
      nh3_value >= 0.05 & nh3_value < 0.1 ~ "0.05 - 0.1",
      nh3_value >= 0.1  & nh3_value < 0.5 ~ "0.1 - 0.5",
      nh3_value >= 0.5  & nh3_value < 1   ~ "0.5 - 1",
      nh3_value >= 1    & nh3_value < 2   ~ "1 - 2",
      nh3_value >= 2    & nh3_value < 4   ~ "2 - 4",
      nh3_value >= 4 ~ "> 4"
    ),
    nh3_class = factor(
      nh3_class,
      levels = c(
        "< 0.05",
        "0.05 - 0.1",
        "0.1 - 0.5",
        "0.5 - 1",
        "1 - 2",
        "2 - 4",
        "> 4"
      )
    )
  )

# ---- SAMHE school coordinates from In_Out_24 ----

school_coordinates <- In_Out_24 %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SchoolId_short,
    SchoolLongitude,
    SchoolLatitude
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(SchoolLongitude),
    !is.na(SchoolLatitude)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    SchoolId_short,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

school_coordinates_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
  school_coordinates,
  coords = c("SchoolLongitude", "SchoolLatitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
) %>%
  sf::st_transform(
    crs = terra::crs(naei_total_nh3)
  )

# ---- Colour scale ----

nh3_class_colours <- viridisLite::viridis(7)

# ---- Plot ----

nh3_static_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = uk_land,
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_raster(
    data = naei_total_nh3_df,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      fill = nh3_class
    )
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = school_coordinates_sf,
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.4,
    stroke = 0.35,
    colour = "black",
    fill = defra_orange,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = uk_land,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.08
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = nh3_class_colours,
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "Ammonia\nUnits tonnes/1x1km"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = sf::st_crs(27700),
    xlim = c(-120000, 720000),
    ylim = c(-20000, 1270000),
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression("NAEI 2023 gridded NH"[3]~"emissions and SAMHE school locations"),
    subtitle = "SAMHE school locations shown as orange circles",
    caption = expression(
      "Background raster shows NAEI 2023 total gridded NH"[3]~
      " emissions. Values are emissions inventory grid values, not measured ambient concentrations."
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

nh3_static_map

ggsave(
  file.path(
    ammonia_fig_dir,
    "NAEI_NH3_static_with_SAMHE_schools.png"
  ),
  plot = nh3_static_map,
  width = 210,
  height = 220,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r plot_school_hours_pm25_vs_nh3_1km}
# ---- Main plot: school-hours classroom PM2.5 versus NH3 context ----

nh3_pm25_1km_plot <- local({

  plot_data <- ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia %>%
    filter(period == "School hours") %>%
    select(
      SchoolId_short,
      indoor_pm25_mean,
      nh3_10agriculture_1km,
      nh3_gridded_sector_sum_1km,
      nh3_total_1km
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("nh3_"),
      names_to = "ammonia_variable",
      values_to = "nh3_value"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(indoor_pm25_mean),
      is.finite(nh3_value),
      nh3_value > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ammonia_variable = recode(
        ammonia_variable,
        nh3_10agriculture_1km = "Agriculture NH3",
        nh3_gridded_sector_sum_1km = "Gridded sector NH3, excluding point sources",
        nh3_total_1km = "Total NH3, including point sources"
      )
    )

  stats_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(ammonia_variable) %>%
    summarise(
      n_schools = n(),
      rho = cor(
        nh3_value,
        indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "spearman",
        use = "complete.obs"
      ),
      p_value = cor.test(
        nh3_value,
        indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "spearman",
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      panel_label = paste0(
        ammonia_variable,
        "\nrho = ",
        round(rho, 3),
        ", p = ",
        signif(p_value, 3),
        ", n = ",
        n_schools
      )
    )

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    left_join(
      stats_data %>% select(ammonia_variable, panel_label),
      by = "ammonia_variable"
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = nh3_value,
      y = indoor_pm25_mean
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.5,
      colour = sheffield_purple
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      colour = "grey25",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ panel_label,
      scales = "free_x"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = expression("School-hours classroom PM"[2.5]~"and NAEI NH"[3]~"emissions context"),
      subtitle = "One point represents one school; NH3 variables use 1 km buffer means",
      x = expression("NAEI 2023 NH"[3]~"emissions context within 1 km buffer (log scale)"),
      y = expression("Mean school-hours classroom PM"[2.5]~"("*mu*"g m"^-3*")"),
      caption = expression("NH"[3]~"values are emissions/source-pressure context, not measured ambient NH"[3]~"concentrations. Only positive NH"[3]~"values are plotted because the x-axis is log-scaled.")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
    )
})
```

```{r plot_school_hours_pm25_vs_agriculture_nh3_buffers}
# ---- Agricultural NH3 buffer-distance sensitivity plot ----

agriculture_buffer_plot <- local({

  plot_data <- ammonia_pm25_results$school_pm25_ammonia %>%
    filter(period == "School hours") %>%
    select(
      SchoolId_short,
      indoor_pm25_mean,
      nh3_10agriculture_1km,
      nh3_10agriculture_2km,
      nh3_10agriculture_5km,
      nh3_10agriculture_10km
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("nh3_10agriculture_"),
      names_to = "buffer",
      values_to = "nh3_value"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(indoor_pm25_mean),
      is.finite(nh3_value),
      nh3_value > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      buffer = recode(
        buffer,
        nh3_10agriculture_1km = "1 km",
        nh3_10agriculture_2km = "2 km",
        nh3_10agriculture_5km = "5 km",
        nh3_10agriculture_10km = "10 km"
      ),
      buffer = factor(
        buffer,
        levels = c("1 km", "2 km", "5 km", "10 km")
      )
    )

  stats_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(buffer) %>%
    summarise(
      n_schools = n(),
      rho = cor(
        nh3_value,
        indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "spearman",
        use = "complete.obs"
      ),
      p_value = cor.test(
        nh3_value,
        indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "spearman",
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      panel_label = paste0(
        buffer,
        "\nrho = ",
        round(rho, 3),
        ", p = ",
        signif(p_value, 3),
        ", n = ",
        n_schools
      )
    )

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    left_join(
      stats_data %>% select(buffer, panel_label),
      by = "buffer"
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = nh3_value,
      y = indoor_pm25_mean
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.5,
      colour = sheffield_purple
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      colour = "grey25",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ panel_label,
      scales = "free_x"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = expression("School-hours classroom PM"[2.5]~"and agricultural NH"[3]~"emissions context"),
      subtitle = "Agricultural NAEI 2023 NH3 tested using 1, 2, 5 and 10 km buffer means",
      x = expression("NAEI 2023 agricultural NH"[3]~"emissions context (log scale)"),
      y = expression("Mean school-hours classroom PM"[2.5]~"("*mu*"g m"^-3*")"),
      caption = expression("NH"[3]~"values are emissions/source-pressure context, not measured ambient NH"[3]~"concentrations. Only positive NH"[3]~"values are plotted because the x-axis is log-scaled.")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
    )
})
```
